_comment: Local reference copy — synced from live n8n on 2026-06-11 (V1.1 pass). Live ID: KIpMMKM8H5IZB9wb. Renamed from 'Hot Lead Alert' to 'Every Lead Alert' — every form submission now triggers an owner notification, with email ON and SMS OFF by default via the CONFIG block in 'Build Alert Content'.
name: Every Lead Alert

parameters.content: Every Lead Alert: receives lead data from any intake workflow, builds a professional HTML email and a short SMS summary, then sends an email to the owner (default ON) and an SMS (default OFF) per the CONFIG block at the top of 'Build Alert Content'. Both channels are toggled per client without redesigning the workflow.
